summary: Static pattern matches in minified bundle without corroborating exfiltration evidence
details: Package @magda/semantic-indexer-sdk ships a bundled dist/index.js containing multiple POST call sites and a string matching 'dyndns' keyword co-occurrence. The matches occur in a minified/bundled artifact where keyword proximity does not distinguish an SDK's normal HTTP client composition from an exfiltration path. No specific installer-side data read is tied to a specific non-first-party destination, no lifecycle hook (preinstall/install/postinstall) is implicated, and no hardcoded attacker C2, credential store enumeration, dropper, or credential-distribution mechanism is demonstrable from the evidence. The package is scoped under @magda, an established open-data platform, and the observed patterns are consistent with an SDK bundle that makes POST requests to configured service endpoints.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
